sentences.text: Southampton Football Club -LSB- saʊθˈæmptən , _ - hæmptən -RSB- is a professional association football club based in Southampton , Hampshire , England , which plays in the Premier League , the top tier of English football .	association football	association football	Southampton	Southampton	Hampshire	Hampshire	Premier League	Premier League	English football	English football league system
Their home ground since 2001 has been St Mary 's Stadium , before which they were based at The Dell .	The Dell	The Dell (Southampton)

The club has been nicknamed `` The Saints '' since its inception in 1885 due to its history as a church football team , founded as St. Mary 's Church of England Young Men 's Association , and play in red and white shirts .

Southampton has a long-standing rivalry with Portsmouth due to its close proximity and both cities ' respective maritime history .	Southampton	Southampton	Portsmouth	Portsmouth F.C.	maritime history	maritime history
Matches between the two sides are known as the South Coast derby .	South Coast derby	South Coast derby
The club has won the FA Cup once , in 1976 , and their highest-ever league finish was second in the First Division in 1983 -- 84 .	FA Cup	FA Cup	1976	1976 FA Cup final
Southampton were relegated from the Premier League on 15 May 2005 , ending 27 successive seasons of top-division football for the club .	Southampton	Southampton	Premier League	Premier League
They returned after a seven-year absence , and have played there ever since .
